annotations.title: Who is gaining share of search in this category?

description: Use when the user asks who they really compete with, whether a competitor is gaining on them, or how their brand interest compares with rivals. Returns each brand's share of US Google searches among the brands named, the change in points against the year before, search growth and a volume band, ranked. Shares and bands only, never monthly volumes. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. For where searchers end up (retailers, reviews, brand sites), use run_channel_mix; for price-seeking searches on one brand, use run_premium_check. A real sample of this run, free: https://cultmath.com/agent/samples/share-of-search.json
